name: voyage_embed
description: Generate embeddings using Voyage AI. Supports voyage-3 (default), voyage-3-lite, voyage-code-3, voyage-finance-2, voyage-law-2, and voyage-multilingual-2 models.

texts.description: Array of text strings to embed

input_type.description: Input type hint: query or document (improves quality)

name: voyage_embed_query
description: Embed a single search query using Voyage AI with query-optimized settings for maximum retrieval relevance. Returns a single embedding vector.

name: voyage_embed_documents
description: Batch embed a list of documents using Voyage AI with document-optimized settings. Best for indexing content into a vector database.

documents.description: Array of document strings to embed

name: voyage_embed_code
description: Embed code snippets using voyage-code-3, Voyage AI's state-of-the-art code embedding model. Best performance for code search and retrieval tasks.

texts.description: Array of code snippets or technical text to embed

name: voyage_embed_finance
description: Embed financial documents using voyage-finance-2. Optimized for financial filings, earnings reports, and economic text. Superior retrieval for finance use cases.

name: voyage_embed_legal
description: Embed legal text using voyage-law-2. Optimized for contracts, case law, statutes, and legal documents. Best-in-class for legal RAG applications.

name: voyage_embed_multilingual
description: Embed text in multiple languages using voyage-multilingual-2. Supports cross-lingual retrieval across 10+ languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, and more.

name: voyage_rerank
description: Rerank a list of candidate documents by relevance to a query using Voyage's cross-encoder reranker. Significantly improves retrieval precision as a post-processing step after vector search.

query.description: Search query to rank documents against

documents.description: Array of document strings to rerank

top_k.description: Return only the top K results (default: all)

return_documents.description: Include document text in results (default: true)

name: voyage_list_models
description: List all available Voyage AI embedding and reranking models with their context lengths, dimensions, and intended use cases.

name: voyage_compare_similarity
description: SUPER TOOL: Embed two texts and return their cosine similarity score (0-1) with a human-readable interpretation. Useful for semantic similarity checks and deduplication.

name: voyage_search_pipeline
description: SUPER TOOL: Full RAG retrieval pipeline — embed query with Voyage + score candidates by cosine similarity + rerank top results in one call. Returns relevance-ranked documents ready to pass to an LLM.

candidate_documents.description: Array of candidate document strings to search through

top_k.description: Number of top results to return (default: 5)
